help.title: Help & Support
help.subtitle: Short answers to common questions. Press a question to read the answer.

addProperty.q: How do I add a property?
addProperty.a: Go to “My Properties” and press “Add a Property”. Follow the 4 short steps. Then add each unit (apartment, house or room) that you rent out.

inviteTenant.q: How do I add a tenant?
inviteTenant.a: Open the unit, choose the “Tenant” tab and press “Invite a tenant”. Fill in the tenant's name and email. You will get a private link: send it by email, SMS or WhatsApp. The tenant opens it to create their account.

reportProblem.q: How do I report a problem?
reportProblem.a: Press the big “Report a Problem” button. Choose the kind of problem, describe it in a few words, add a photo if you can, and press “Send”. You will get a reference number.

trackRepair.q: How do I follow a repair?
trackRepair.a: Open “My Requests” (tenants) or “Maintenance” (landlords). Each request shows its status and a history of every step: reported, reviewed, repair started, resolved.

inspection.a: An inspection is a dated check of the home, room by room. Choose Good, Needs attention or Damaged for each part and add photos. When you finish, the record is locked so it can be trusted later, for example when a tenant moves out.

rent.a: Go to “Rent & Finances” and press “Record a payment”. Rental_Control only keeps records — it does not send or receive money.

language.q: How do I change the language?
language.a: Use the “Language” menu at the top of every page. Your choice is saved in your account.

textSize.q: Can I make the text bigger?
textSize.a: Yes. Go to Settings (or Profile) and choose “Larger text”. You can also use your browser zoom.

privacy.title: Privacy information
privacy.subtitle: How Rental_Control uses your information, in plain words.

what.title: What we keep
what.text: Your name, email and phone number; the properties and units you manage; inspections, photos, repair requests, expenses and rent records that you or your tenants add.

why.title: Why we keep it
why.text: Only to run the service: to show you your records, to tell people about updates, and to keep a trustworthy history of each home.

who.title: Who can see it
who.text: Landlords see only their own properties. Property managers see only the properties an owner gave them. Tenants see only their own home, their own requests and the records shared with them. A new tenant cannot see a previous tenant's requests.

photos.title: Photos and evidence
photos.text: Photos are private. They are only shown to signed-in people who are allowed to see that record. Completed inspections cannot be changed, so they stay reliable. Rental_Control never decides who caused damage — people do.

rights.title: Your choices
rights.text: You can correct your details in Settings. To delete your account or get a copy of your data, contact support.

storage.title: Where it is stored
storage.text: Data is stored on the servers chosen by the operator of this Rental_Control installation. Passwords are stored in a protected (hashed) form.
